confirmed_findings.evidence: workflow_dispatch model_name was interpolated directly into run-script commands while HF_TOKEN was available in the same job; the job uploaded to a Hugging Face model repository without a per-run confirmation gate.
confirmed_findings.correction: Require confirm_external_change=YES, pass model_name through an environment variable, validate a strict lowercase slug, quote all uses, disable checkout credential persistence and remove stored Git credentials.

confirmed_findings.evidence: The workflow was byte-for-byte equivalent in behavior to barrot-merge.yml and had the same token exposure and unvalidated model_name interpolation.
confirmed_findings.correction: Apply the same per-run confirmation and strict model-name validation.

confirmed_findings.evidence: Manual dispatch used HF_TOKEN to DELETE the Barrot-Omega-v2 Space repository and POST creation of a different Space, without a confirmation input.
confirmed_findings.correction: Make the workflow inert with empty permissions pending a separately reviewed, target-specific migration.

confirmed_findings.evidence: Manual dispatch called the Hugging Face Space restart endpoint with factory=true and no explicit confirmation input.
confirmed_findings.correction: Require confirm_external_change=YES; give the workflow no repository-token permissions.

confirmed_findings.evidence: A push to main affecting self_hosted_brain/** automatically uploaded the folder to a Hugging Face Space and could propagate a shared secret; manual dispatch was also available without an approval gate.
confirmed_findings.correction: Remove the push trigger and require confirm_external_change=YES for manual deployment.

confirmed_findings.evidence: A push to main affecting a2a/** automatically deployed a Cloudflare Worker and uploaded GROQ_API_KEY and BRAIN_SHARED_SECRET; manual dispatch had no approval gate.
confirmed_findings.correction: Remove the push trigger and require confirm_external_change=YES for manual deployment.

confirmed_findings.evidence: The workflow exposed GROQ_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY and CHATGPT_TOKEN to a task allocator, held contents:write and pull-requests:write, listed secret names, dispatched tasks and committed allocation records to main. No nine-platform capability/authentication/permission/data-flow verification was established.
confirmed_findings.correction: Disable the workflow and remove all token access until the nine-platform adapter map and independent permission tests exist.
